name: Gyaru x Ota ~Orikawa Kirara wa Osewa Shitai~
original_name: ギャル×オタ　～織川きららはお世話したい～
source:
I used to think there was no such thing as a gal who’d be nice to an otaku like me. The proof? My childhood friend from next door, Kirara Orikawa, stopped talking to me the second she turned into a full-blown gal. Gals don’t give a damn about guys like me—nerds, losers, the kind of people who spend their weekends glued to a screen instead of living life.

Or so I thought.

Everything changed when I saved her from getting hit by a car. I got hurt in the process, but that stupid, reckless act of heroism flipped some kind of switch. Suddenly, Kirara wasn’t just nice to me—she was all over me. Turns out, gals aren’t just nice to otaku. They’re sweet, clingy, and… really fucking horny.

[Translated from [url=http://www.confiture-soft.com/products/gyaruota/#story]the official website[/url]]
translation:
我曾以为，世上根本不存在对我这种宅男友善的辣妹。证据？住在隔壁的青梅竹马织川きらら，一变成彻头彻尾的辣妹，就不再和我说话了。辣妹才不会在乎我这种人——书呆子、失败者，把周末全耗在屏幕前，而不是好好生活的家伙。

至少，我原本是这么想的。

直到我救下差点被车撞到的她，一切都变了。我因此受了伤，可这场愚蠢、鲁莽的英雄救美，似乎拨动了什么开关。きらら突然不只是对我友善，而是黏得不得了。原来，辣妹对宅男不只是温柔，还会撒娇、黏人，而且……特别好色。

[译自[url=http://www.confiture-soft.com/products/gyaruota/#story]官方网站[/url]]
